action.objective: Develop the light-square bishop to f3, keeping the queen-side knight active and preparing central play.
action.rationale: e2f3 is the only commit_ready move: verified at depth 3-4 with an exact score of +83 (best of all candidates), no immediate mate-in-one, and no found tactical refutation. Black's Qxf3 is a legal capture but the bishop is defended by Qd1 and Pg2, so it is not a free loss. Bf3 also develops and eyes c6/d5. Commit.
